name: Harbor Market
subtitle: Fixed-price NFT marketplace
description: Example 3 — escrow listings, EIP-2981 royalty split, pull payments. The F-01 reentrancy playbook.
long_description: Sellers escrow an NFT with a fixed price. Buyers pay the exact amount and receive the NFT immediately; proceeds are never pushed - they accrue as credits for the seller and the royalty receiver, who each withdraw on their own. Settlement is finalized before the NFT transfer, every entry point is reentrancy-guarded, and cancel/withdraw stay open even under a full brake. Royalty is honored via EIP-2981 when the collection supports it (code-length checked first) and clamped at 100%.
